name: PB1 polymerase subunit
note: Segment 1, 519 aa, catalytic SDD at 288-290. The only TiLV protein with recognisable homology to anything outside the family.

name: PB2 polymerase subunit
note: Segment 2, 457 aa. Assigned by fold in the cryo-EM polymerase structure. Deposited only as 'hypothetical protein'.

name: PA polymerase subunit
note: Segment 3, 419 aa. Assigned by fold. Deposited only as 'hypothetical protein'.

name: nucleoprotein
note: Segment 4, 356 aa. Identified biochemically then structurally bound to RNA. Deposited only as 'hypothetical protein'.

name: S9-F3 nuclear export protein
note: THE ELEVENTH PROTEIN. 105 aa from frame 3 of segment 9, overlapping the primary S9 ORF, confirmed by mass spectrometry (4 unique peptides, 49% coverage) and carrying a CRM1-dependent nuclear export signal. Expected ABSENT: BV-BRC holds no deposit of it. Sourced by extraction from the genomes instead.

name: spliced mRNA product
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. Orthomyxoviruses make nuclear export proteins from spliced segment 7/8 mRNAs, but PMID 41513822 looked for splicing in TiLV and reports none: S9-F3 arises by leaky ribosomal scanning of an alternative frame. ABSENT here is the correct result and confirms no influenza splicing rule has leaked in.

name: PA-X frameshift product
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. PMID 41513822 states it could not identify an obvious PA-X-like frameshift signal in segment 3, so no frameshift product is declared.

name: matrix protein
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. No amnoonvirid matrix protein has been described; segments 5-10 have no assigned function beyond predicted motifs.
